source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Identify the names and job titles of all involved employees, including injured employees.
3. Note the date and time the accident occurred.
4. Include a detailed description of the incident, highlighting the events leading up to the accident, the exact moment of the accident, and the immediate aftermath.
5. Document the location of the accident, including specific details about the area, equipment, and any other relevant environmental factors.
6. Describe any injuries sustained by the victims, detailing the nature and severity of each injury.
7. Reference any witnesses and record their statements, ensuring their contact information is documented.
8. Photograph the scene of the accident, if safe and permissible to do so, to accompany your report.
9. Detail the immediate actions taken after the accident, such as first aid administered, emergency services contacted, etc.
10. List any equipment or tools that were involved or may have contributed to the accident.
11. Outline any safety protocols or procedures that were not
